install.tail:
Kazma's container engine (Docker as a service, started at boot):
  NO   WSL 2
  NO   the kazma-engine WSL distro
  NO   Docker Engine in it, answering
  NO   Docker's command-line tools
  NO   the kazma-engine Docker context
  NO   the KazmaEngine task (starts it at boot, nobody signed in)
  NO   the KazmaEngineShutdown service (stops it cleanly when Windows shuts down)
The plan:
   1. install WSL 2 (pinned release) for Kazma's container engine
   2. create the kazma-engine WSL distro (Ubuntu 24.04, pinned image)
   3. install Docker Engine in it, with its TLS keys
   4. install Docker's command-line tools for Windows (pinned)
   5. connect Windows to it (the kazma-engine Docker context)
   6. start it at boot with nobody signed in (the KazmaEngine task)
   7. stop it cleanly when Windows shuts down (the KazmaEngineShutdown service)
   8. check it answers, and record it
-> install WSL 2 (pinned release) for Kazma's container engine
   WSL is installed; Windows must restart before the engine can be created
Restart Windows to finish WSL, then run kazma setup engine again: it continues where it stopped.

Kazma's container engine (Docker as a service, started at boot):
  ok   WSL 2
  NO   the kazma-engine WSL distro
  NO   Docker Engine in it, answering
  NO   Docker's command-line tools
  NO   the kazma-engine Docker context
  NO   the KazmaEngine task (starts it at boot, nobody signed in)
  NO   the KazmaEngineShutdown service (stops it cleanly when Windows shuts down)
The plan:
   1. create the kazma-engine WSL distro (Ubuntu 24.04, pinned image)
   2. install Docker Engine in it, with its TLS keys
   3. install Docker's command-line tools for Windows (pinned)
   4. connect Windows to it (the kazma-engine Docker context)
   5. start it at boot with nobody signed in (the KazmaEngine task)
   6. stop it cleanly when Windows shuts down (the KazmaEngineShutdown service)
   7. check it answers, and record it
-> create the kazma-engine WSL distro (Ubuntu 24.04, pinned image)
   created
-> install Docker Engine in it, with its TLS keys
   the engine's networks: 10.213.0.1/24, pool 10.213.128.0/17
   ENGINE_READY Docker version 29.9.3, build 70efc0e
-> install Docker's command-line tools for Windows (pinned)
   docker.exe in C:\Users\KazmaDrill_1\AppData\Local\Kazma\engine\bin, compose plugin in C:\Users\KazmaDrill_1\.docker\cli-plugins
-> connect Windows to it (the kazma-engine Docker context)
   context kazma-engine (created)
-> start it at boot with nobody signed in (the KazmaEngine task)
   KazmaEngine registered and started
-> stop it cleanly when Windows shuts down (the KazmaEngineShutdown service)
   KazmaEngineShutdown runs: at a shutdown it stops the engine's containers first (up to 120 s)
-> check it answers, and record it
   Kazma's engine answers (Docker 29.9.3)
Kazma's engine is set up: it starts at boot, with nobody signed in.
